title: VOICE_CONTEXT_V1
description: Compiled context handed to scholarly-voice-engine so it does not have to re-derive discipline/genre/journal policy itself. Populated from a SCHOLARLY_PROFILE_V1 and/or a JOURNAL_STYLE_CONTEXT_V1 when those are available; scholarly-voice-engine must fall back to its own built-in discipline/genre policy when this context (or any of its fields) is absent (see shared/capability-boundaries.md, rule 43).

author_voice.description: Composite/abstracted traits only -- never a direct-imitation instruction for a third-party living author (shared/integrity-policy.md).

limitations.description: e.g. 'discipline_profile unavailable, using built-in policy', 'journal context stale'.
